title: GET /api/box/trades/history (200)
description: Source: src/box/routes.ts GET /api/box/trades/history. Two scope envelopes, distinguished by the scope const. scope=all returns the full serializeBoxTrade list (trades element = box-trade). scope=today returns LITE rows whose execution-audit blobs are stripped (see liteClosedTrade); their exact reduced field set is engine-owned, so the today trades element is pinned as an OPEN object while the ENVELOPE around it is CLOSED. Validated against a real scope=all response (direct serializer) and a real empty scope=today envelope.

trades.$comment: OPEN element by design: lite closed-today rows have execution-audit blobs stripped; the reduced shape is engine-owned (liteClosedTrade).
